answer.rationale: memory_73 (promotional pricing) is least supported for sustainable long-term qualified revenue because it directly addresses price sensitivity through discounting, which can erode margins, commoditize the offering, and attract customers likely to churn when pricing normalizes—all working against durability. memory_86 (shortening onboarding) is most supported because faster time-to-value demonstrably improves activation and adoption, creating stickier, more engaged accounts with stronger retention foundations. memory_31, memory_57, and memory_91 all show strong support through durable behavioral improvements (activation, referral quality, engagement). memory_44 (sales-assisted flows) shows moderate support: while it improves pipeline quality, it is capital-intensive and less scalable than product-driven mechanisms, making it less suitable as a primary lever for sustainable growth.
